name: megaweave-image-resizer
description: AWS Lambda function to resize images uploaded to S3

scripts.build: esbuild index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.mjs --external:sharp --external:@aws-sdk/* && cp -r node_modules dist/ && cd dist && zip -r ../function.zip .
scripts.package: npm run type-check && npm run install:linux && npm run build
